subject: WillowTech: CAIQ runbook walkthrough, evidence checklist & next steps
messages:
From: Erin Patel <erin.patel@willowtech.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@willowtech.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: WillowTech security intake — CAIQ walkthrough and evidence requests

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for taking this on. WillowTech is kicking off our vendor assurance review for Q4 and we'd like to schedule a CAIQ/SIG walkthrough so we can align on what evidence you’ll provide and a short timeline. Our primary goals for the call:

- Walk through Redwood's CAIQ responses and where we expect supporting artifacts (logs, configs, SOC 2 sections).
- Confirm log retention windows, export formats, and sample access (S3/CloudTrail/ELK).
- Understand your encryption key management and BYOK options.
- Agree on a cadence for artifact handoff (one-time bundle vs. incremental uploads).

Would a 60-minute slot work? We're available:
- Tue 2026-09-09 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 2026-09-10 14:00–15:00 PT
- Thu 2026-09-11 09:00–10:00 PT

Please also include anyone from your side who owns logging retention or compliance artifacts.

Thanks,
Erin
Erin Patel
Senior Security Analyst, WillowTech
erin.patel@willowtech.com
security_review@willowtech.com

P.S. attaching our intake checklist — we prefer pre-populated CAIQs if possible.

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Erin Patel <erin.patel@willowtech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: WillowTech security intake — CAIQ walkthrough and evidence requests

Hi Erin — thanks for the note and the checklist. Happy to run the walkthrough. 60 minutes works. Proposed: Tue 2026-09-09 10:00 PT (we’ll lock if that works for your team).

Attendees from our side: Ben Carter (Security Ops, logs/retention owner), Marissa Cole (Compliance lead).

Pre-call materials (attached):
- Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2026.pdf (summary of scope & auditor)
- Redwood_CA IQ_Prefill_Template.xlsx (CAIQ answers we've prefilled to speed the review)

Suggested agenda for the call (high level):
1) Introductions & scope (10m)
2) CAIQ high-level walk / clarifications (20m)
3) Logs & evidence: retention, export, samples (15m)
4) Action items & handoff plan (15m)

If you want us to pre-share specific logs (anonymized samples / sanitized exports), tell us the format and delivery method (Drive link or S3 presigned). Also let us know if WillowTech requires an NDA before we share any internal artefacts — happy to route to legal.

If Tue 10:00 PT works, I'll send a calendar invite with a shared Drive folder for artifacts.

Best,

--
Soojin Lee
Principal, Security & Compliance (Vendor Assurance)
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0149

Attachment stubs: Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2026.pdf (PDF, 420KB); Redwood_CA IQ_Prefill_Template.xlsx (Excel, 120KB)

From: Erin Patel <erin.patel@willowtech.com>

Date: 2026-09-08T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: WillowTech security intake — CAIQ walkthrough and evidence requests

Confirmed — Tue 2026-09-09 10:00 PT works for us.

A couple of quick asks before the call:
- Please add security_review@willowtech.com to the calendar invite so our intake queue receives the recording and artifacts.
- Can you confirm whether you support export of raw access logs (CloudTrail) in gzipped JSON and whether those exports can be scoped by tenant ID for sample pulls?
- If possible, pre-fill any CAIQ responses tied to key management (KMS/HSM) and log retention so we can zero in on open questions during the call.

Also linking our standard NDA template here (DocuSign link) — if Redwood prefers one-sided, we can route.

Thanks,
Erin

--
Erin Patel
Senior Security Analyst, WillowTech
erin.patel@willowtech.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Erin Patel <erin.patel@willowtech.com>, security_review@willowtech.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: WillowTech security intake — CAIQ walkthrough and evidence requests — meeting notes & actions

Thanks everyone for the call this morning — below are the notes and agreed actions. Recording and an artifacts folder have been shared to the Drive link included in the calendar invite.

Meeting notes (summary):
- Scope affirmed: WillowTech will assess Redwood's CAIQ + SOC 2 artifacts for vendor assurance; no additional audit requested at this time.
- Key clarifications provided:
  - Redwood supports export of request/operation logs and CloudTrail-equivalent traces as gzipped JSON; Ben will provide a sanitized sample scoped by tenant ID.
  - Retention: default access/log retention is 90 days in hot storage with 12 months archived; retention windows can be extended under Dedicated/Private contracts — product team follow-up needed for contractual exceptions.
  - Key management: Redwood uses customer KMS integrations for Dedicated & Private deployments; hosted customers are encrypted at rest with provider-managed KMS; KMS architecture doc referenced in CAIQ prefill.

Action items (owner — due):
- Ben Carter (Redwood): provide a sanitized CloudTrail-style sample (gzipped JSON) scoped to a demo tenant + short README describing field mapping — due 2026-09-15.
- Marissa Cole (Redwood): update CAIQ prefill answers for KMS, retention, and logging endpoints; upload revised CAIQ to Drive — due 2026-09-14.
- WillowTech security_review@willowtech.com: confirm whether the sanitized sample format satisfies intake; provide any additional checklist items by 2026-09-18.
- Soojin Lee (Redwood): follow up with Product on contractual retention extension options and get a short note for WillowTech by 2026-09-17.

Deliverables shared/attachments:
- Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2026.pdf (attached to original email)
- Redwood_CA IQ_Prefill_Template_v1.xlsx (updated will be uploaded to Drive)
- Placeholder: meeting-recording-placeholder.txt (recording pending upload; will replace with Drive link)

Related links: Drive folder (shared in calendar), HubSpot record for WillowTech (company ID 98765), DocuSign NDA link (if required).

If any of the owners above need different due dates, reply-all and we’ll adjust. Otherwise we’ll treat the dates as agreed.

Thanks again — looking forward to closing the open items so you can move to the next stage of your review.

Regards,

--
Soojin Lee
Principal, Security & Compliance (Vendor Assurance)
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
